title: UC San Diego to Test Innovative Power Technology for AI Data Centers
snippet: The San Diego Supercomputer Center (SDSC) at UC San Diego will serve as the testing ground for a new $8.48 million California Energy Commission-funded project to transform how AI data centers receive and manage electricity. Chancellor Pradeep K. Khosla is quoted on the project's potential.
match_reason: websearch (press_quote) — Chancellor Pradeep K. Khosla is a featured quoted source in this official UC San Diego press release regarding a new project to test power technology for AI data centers.

title: Physical Intelligence: AI and Robots in Our Future
snippet: Ken Goldberg delivered a public lecture at the 23rd IFAC World Congress in Busan, South Korea, exploring how AI is transforming the physical world through robotics. He discussed 'Physical Intelligence' — applying AI to sensors and motors — and addressed the technical and social challenges of robot learning.
